summary: Boot briefings kept surfacing the Steve Hall follow-up delegation as overdue even after David cleared it as actively handled on 2026-10-09. The tracker note said 'no nudge needed' but the row stayed In Progress with a past due date, so every gather pass re-flagged it.
correction: Stop bringing up the Steve Hall follow-up. It is handled. Follow-up correction same turn: closed means DELETED so I never hear about it again.
fix_applied: Row deleted from the delegation tracker entirely (both active and completed sections). No OmniFocus mirror exists (removed 2026-09-17). Zero references remain.
systemic_rule: When David says a delegation is handled, delete the tracker row outright, do not park it in a Completed section to be re-read later. 'Closed' for cleared delegations means removed from the file, not moved to a section that future gather passes still scan. Follow-up: the Completed section itself was also wrong — completed rows sat in tracker.md where every gather pass loads them into context, inviting accidental inclusion in briefings. Fixed 2026-10-29: all completed rows moved to `delegations/archive-2026-02.md` (a file no gather pass reads), Completed section emptied, and the section header now says archive immediately when done. Rule: completed delegations go to `delegations/archive-YYYY-MM.md`, never linger in tracker.md.
